title: Integrating Generative Artificial Intelligence with Learning Style Models: Opportunities, Challenges, and Future Directions
abstract: arXiv:2611.27868v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI) has emerged as a powerful tool for transforming learning. This review examines how Generative AI can be integrated with established learning style models (VARK, Kolb, Felder-Silverman, and Honey & Mumford) to support student engagement in large online classes. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, we searched Scopus, IEEE Xplore, and Google Scholar (2015 to 2026) and included 41 studies that met the eligibility criteria. The review maps Generative AI capabilities to learning style preferences, synthesizes existing implementations, highlights benefits and challenges, and proposes pathways for future research and practice. Despite ongoing debates regarding the empirical validity of learning styles, Generative AI enables flexible, multimodal, and real-time adaptation. translated_title: 将生成式人工智能与学习风格模型相整合：机遇、挑战与未来方向
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能已成为变革学习的强大工具。本综述探讨了如何将生成式人工智能与成熟的学习风格模型（VARK、Kolb、Felder-Silverman 以及 Honey & Mumford）相整合，以支持大型在线课堂中的学生参与。研究遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南，检索了 Scopus、IEEE Xplore 和 Google Scholar（2015至2026年）数据库，最终纳入41项符合资格标准的研究。该综述将生成式人工智能的能力与学习风格偏好进行映射，综合了现有的实施案例，突出了其益处与挑战，并为未来的研究与实践提出了路径。尽管关于学习风格实证有效性的争论仍在持续，生成式人工智能能够实现灵活、多模态且实时的适应性学习。本研究为寻求构建更有效、以学习者为中心的学习系统的教育者和开发者提供了实践性见解。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了41项研究，探讨生成式人工智能与VARK、Kolb等经典学习风格模型整合以支持大型在线课堂学生参与的机遇、挑战与未来方向，并指出AI可实现灵活、多模态、实时的个性化学习适应。
en_tdlr: This review systematically examines 41 studies on integrating Generative AI with established learning style models (VARK, Kolb, etc.) to support student engagement in large online classes, mapping AI capabilities to learning preferences and highlighting opportunities, challenges, and future research pathways.
